# eGenius

> > eGenius is a comprehensive Campus ERP and College Management System designed to streamline student management, academic administration, and institutional operations for K-12 and higher education institutions.

eGenius ERP provides integrated solutions for campus administration, student lifecycle management, and academic operations. The platform combines cloud-based technology with specialized modules for attendance tracking, library management, course administration, and exam management to support modern educational institutions.
